answer_1.quote: We propose Automatic Multi-Agent Chart Evolution (AMACE)... The Chart Replier (CR) generates responses based on chart analysis... We assess performance on ChartQA and Chart-to-Text datasets.

answer_2.quote: In ChartQA, performance represents the accuracy of each dataset. In Chart-to-Text, ROUGEScore refers to the ROUGE-L F1 score. BERTScore is also reported.

answer_3.quote: The role of the CQE is to assess the quality of answers provided by the CR regarding the generated chart. It evaluates how effectively the chart conveys information and outputs whether the response is correct or incorrect, along with an explanation.
methods: quality evaluation via CQE prompt (correct/incorrect judgement)

answer_4.quote: To evaluate the quality of generated charts across iterative steps, we conducted a human evaluation in which five annotators rated charts generated from 150 data samples. Participants were asked to rate each chart on a scale from 1 (least suitable) to 5 (most suitable) based on how well the chart matched the intended query and conveyed the relevant information.
answer_4.guideline: Rate charts on a 1‑5 scale according to suitability to the query and information conveyance.
